description: Abstract class AndroidLightClassBase extending LightElement, implementing PsiClass and SyntheticElement, providing base functionality for Android-related light classes in IntelliJ IDEA plugin development.

classes.name: AndroidLightClassBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for Android light classes in IntelliJ IDEA plugin, providing default implementations for PsiClass interface and preventing modifications.

methods.name: checkAdd
methods.description: Throws IncorrectOperationException to prevent adding elements to R class.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Throws IncorrectOperationException to prevent adding elements.

methods.name: addBefore
methods.description: Throws IncorrectOperationException to prevent adding elements before a specified anchor.

methods.name: addAfter
methods.description: Throws IncorrectOperationException to prevent adding elements after a specified anchor.

methods.name: isInterface
methods.description: Returns false, indicating this class is not an interface.

methods.name: isAnnotationType
methods.description: Returns false, indicating this class is not an annotation type.

methods.name: isEnum
methods.description: Returns false, indicating this class is not an enum.

methods.name: getExtendsList
methods.description: Returns an empty LightEmptyImplementsList for extends list.

methods.name: getImplementsList
methods.description: Returns an empty LightEmptyImplementsList for implements list.

methods.name: getExtendsListTypes
methods.description: Returns an empty array of PsiClassType.

methods.name: getImplementsListTypes
methods.description: Returns an empty array of PsiClassType.

methods.name: getSuperClass
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no superclass.

methods.name: getInterfaces
methods.description: Returns an empty array of PsiClass.

methods.name: getSupers
methods.description: Returns an empty array of PsiClass.

methods.name: getSuperTypes
methods.description: Returns an empty array of PsiClassType.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an empty array of PsiField.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Returns an empty array of PsiMethod.

methods.name: getConstructors
methods.description: Returns an empty array of PsiMethod.

methods.name: getInnerClasses
methods.description: Returns an empty array of PsiClass.

methods.name: getInitializers
methods.description: Returns an empty array of PsiClassInitializer.

methods.name: findFieldByName
methods.description: Finds a field by name among the class's fields.

methods.name: findMethodBySignature
methods.description: Returns null, no method found.

methods.name: findMethodsBySignature
methods.description: Returns an empty array of PsiMethod.

methods.name: findMethodsByName
methods.description: Returns an empty array of PsiMethod.

methods.name: findMethodsAndTheirSubstitutorsByName
methods.description: Returns an empty list.

methods.name: getAllMethodsAndTheirSubstitutors
methods.description: Returns an empty list.

methods.name: findInnerClassByName
methods.description: Returns null, no inner class found.

methods.name: getLBrace
methods.description: Returns null, no left brace element.

methods.name: getRBrace
methods.description: Returns null, no right brace element.

methods.name: getNameIdentifier
methods.description: Returns null, no name identifier.

methods.name: getScope
methods.description: Returns null, no scope.

methods.name: isInheritor
methods.description: Checks if this class inherits from another class.

methods.name: isInheritorDeep
methods.description: Checks deep inheritance from another class.

methods.name: getVisibleSignatures
methods.description: Returns an empty collection of visible method signatures.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Throws IncorrectOperationException, name change not supported.

methods.name: getDocComment
methods.description: Returns null, no documentation comment.

methods.name: isDeprecated
methods.description: Returns false, class is not deprecated.

methods.name: hasTypeParameters
methods.description: Returns false, no type parameters.

methods.name: getTypeParameterList
methods.description: Returns a new LightTypeParameterListBuilder.

methods.name: getTypeParameters
methods.description: Returns an empty array of PsiTypeParameter.

methods.name: getModifierList
methods.description: Returns a LightModifierList with public, static, final modifiers.

methods.name: hasModifierProperty
methods.description: Checks if the class has a specific modifier property.

methods.name: isVisibilitySupported
methods.description: Returns true, visibility is supported.

methods.name: getElementIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon for the class.

methods.name: isEquivalentTo
methods.description: Checks if this class is equivalent to another PSI element.

methods.name: getUseScope
methods.description: Returns the use scope of the class.

methods.name: getPresentation
methods.description: Returns presentation info for UI.

methods.name: getContainingFile
methods.description: Returns the file containing this class.
